summary: CAISO files its large load tariff amendment a second time on November 16, 2026, in ER27-532-000, under a different filing code. The text is identical to its filing in ER27-506-000: a 50 MW large load definition, co-location disclosure by generators, and a Flexible Interim Load Interconnection service. Deposits, security and cost recovery sit in the owners' tariffs.
ask: Accept the revisions effective February 16, 2027, with scheduling coordinator changes on November 1, 2027 and settlement changes on April 30, 2028.

points.point: CAISO says its revisions, with the transmission owners', answer the show cause order.
points.quote: Taken together, the CAISO and Participating Transmission Owner (PTO) tariff revisions supply the tariff-level clarity, customer protections, and operational tools the Order seeks.

points.point: Deposits, security and cost recovery are left to each transmission owner's tariff.
points.quote: the PTOs will implement just and reasonable deposit, security, reimbursement, and cost-recovery provisions in their own tariffs

points.point: Generator interconnection customers must disclose plans to serve co-located load.
points.quote: requires generator interconnection customers to disclose plans to serve co- located load

points.point: The interim service lets flexible loads energize before network upgrades are finished.
points.quote: The CAISO’s Flexible Interim Load Interconnection (FILI) can permit earlier energization while network upgrades are pending

points.point: A permanent flexible service is left for later work.
points.quote: with additional work planned on permanent flexibility and other emerging configurations

points.point: A large load is a single site of 50 MW or more.
points.quote: and that has a peak load of 50 MW or greater.

points.point: Loads already operating or with a complete request before February 16, 2027 are not treated as large loads.
points.quote: the CAISO will not consider any load a large load subject to the CAISO tariff where the load is operational or has a complete request with the PTO before the CAISO tariff revisions’ effective date of February 16, 2027

points.point: CAISO asks for a February 16, 2027 effective date.
points.quote: the CAISO requests that the Commission accept the tariff revisions contained in this filing effective February 16, 2027

throughLine.text: Filed under section 205 to answer the E-10 show cause order for CAISO. This is a resubmission of the ER27-506 filing under a different filing code, with the same page text.

figures.label: Large load threshold
figures.quote: peak load of 50 MW or greater
